description: Controlled vocabulary defining canonical diagnostic, inspection, verification, measurement, testing, and corrective actions available to A.R.I.A. during microwave backhaul reasoning.

action_types.name: CHECK_RSL
action_types.description: Obtain the current received signal level for the applicable radio or RF path.

action_types.name: COMPARE_RSL_TO_EXPECTED
action_types.description: Compare measured RSL against the applicable engineered, expected, historical, or reference RSL.

action_types.name: COMPARE_MAIN_DIVERSITY_RSL
action_types.description: Compare corresponding Main and Diversity receive levels.

action_types.name: COMPARE_LOCAL_REMOTE_RSL
action_types.description: Compare corresponding receive levels between opposite microwave endpoints.

action_types.name: CHECK_TX_POWER
action_types.description: Obtain current transmit power for the applicable radio or RF path.

action_types.name: COMPARE_TX_POWER
action_types.description: Compare actual transmit power against configured, expected, design, or opposite-end values.

action_types.name: CHECK_SNR
action_types.description: Obtain current signal-to-noise ratio.

action_types.name: CHECK_SINR
action_types.description: Obtain current signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio.

action_types.name: CHECK_XPD
action_types.description: Obtain or calculate cross-polarization discrimination.

action_types.name: CHECK_MODULATION
action_types.description: Obtain current modulation or adaptive modulation state.

action_types.name: CHECK_ERROR_PERFORMANCE
action_types.description: Review available BER, errored seconds, severely errored seconds, unavailable seconds, packet errors, or related performance metrics.

action_types.name: REVIEW_CONFIGURATION
action_types.description: Review relevant equipment configuration against the applicable expected technical state.

action_types.name: VERIFY_FREQUENCY
action_types.description: Verify configured transmit and receive frequencies against the applicable design and corresponding endpoint.

action_types.name: VERIFY_CHANNEL_BANDWIDTH
action_types.description: Verify channel bandwidth against design and corresponding endpoint configuration.

action_types.name: VERIFY_TX_POWER_CONFIGURATION
action_types.description: Verify configured transmit power and applicable power limits.

action_types.name: VERIFY_ATPC_CONFIGURATION
action_types.description: Verify ATPC state, target, limits, and associated parameters.

action_types.name: VERIFY_MODULATION_CONFIGURATION
action_types.description: Verify modulation, ACM, coding, and related capacity settings.

action_types.name: VERIFY_TOPOLOGY
action_types.description: Verify configured radio topology, protection arrangement, diversity arrangement, or aggregation architecture.

action_types.name: COMPARE_ENDPOINT_CONFIGURATIONS
action_types.description: Compare corresponding configuration values between both microwave endpoints.

action_types.name: COMPARE_CONFIGURATION_TO_DESIGN
action_types.description: Compare current equipment configuration with applicable engineering or commissioning design data.

action_types.name: INSPECT_RF_CHAIN
action_types.description: Physically inspect the applicable RF path and its components from radio through antenna interface.

action_types.name: VERIFY_RF_ROUTING
action_types.description: Verify that RF components and paths are routed to the correct ports and corresponding equipment.

action_types.name: VERIFY_MAIN_DIVERSITY_ROUTING
action_types.description: Verify physical Main and Diversity RF routing against the required architecture.

action_types.name: INSPECT_RF_CONNECTIONS
action_types.description: Inspect applicable RF connections for seating, engagement, torque, damage, contamination, moisture, and mechanical condition.

action_types.name: VERIFY_COMPONENT_MATING
action_types.description: Verify that applicable RF components are correctly oriented, seated, engaged, and mated.

action_types.name: INSPECT_WAVEGUIDE
action_types.description: Inspect waveguide or equivalent RF transmission medium for damage, deformation, contamination, water ingress, and installation defects.

action_types.name: VERIFY_INSTALLED_HARDWARE
action_types.description: Verify installed equipment and components against required design, bill of material, product, frequency band, and compatibility requirements.

action_types.name: VERIFY_COMPONENT_ORIENTATION
action_types.description: Verify physical orientation of applicable components against installation requirements.

action_types.name: VERIFY_AZIMUTH
action_types.description: Compare actual antenna azimuth with applicable path design.

action_types.name: VERIFY_ELEVATION
action_types.description: Compare actual antenna elevation with applicable path design.

action_types.name: VERIFY_POLARIZATION
action_types.description: Verify installed polarization and polarization orientation against applicable design.

action_types.name: PERFORM_ANTENNA_ALIGNMENT
action_types.description: Physically adjust antenna pointing to optimize the applicable microwave path according to approved procedure.

action_types.name: INSPECT_LINE_OF_SIGHT
action_types.description: Inspect the physical microwave path for obstructions or changed path conditions.

action_types.name: VERIFY_FRESNEL_CLEARANCE
action_types.description: Evaluate applicable Fresnel-zone clearance against path requirements.

action_types.name: VERIFY_PATH_DESIGN
action_types.description: Review path engineering data including endpoints, distance, antenna heights, frequencies, azimuths, elevations, and applicable propagation assumptions.

action_types.name: VERIFY_ANTENNA_HEIGHT
action_types.description: Compare installed antenna height against applicable path design.

action_types.name: CHECK_FOR_INTERFERENCE
action_types.description: Evaluate available RF measurements, spectrum information, alarms, or other evidence for interference.

action_types.name: CHECK_WEATHER_CONDITIONS
action_types.description: Review relevant current or historical weather conditions for correlation with observed RF behavior.

action_types.name: CHECK_INPUT_VOLTAGE
action_types.description: Measure or obtain equipment input voltage.

action_types.name: INSPECT_POWER_CONNECTIONS
action_types.description: Inspect equipment power wiring, connectors, polarity, terminations, and associated physical connections.

action_types.name: VERIFY_FIRMWARE_VERSION
action_types.description: Identify installed firmware and compare it with applicable compatibility or release requirements.

action_types.name: REVIEW_ACTIVE_ALARMS
action_types.description: Review current equipment alarms and relevant alarm history.

action_types.name: SWAP_RADIO
action_types.description: Replace or exchange a suspected radio with a known-good or alternate unit to determine whether the fault follows the radio.

action_types.name: SWAP_RF_COMPONENT
action_types.description: Replace or exchange a suspected RF component with a known-good or alternate component to determine whether the fault follows the component.

action_types.name: SWAP_MAIN_DIVERSITY_PATH
action_types.description: Perform an approved controlled swap of Main and Diversity path elements to determine whether a symptom follows a physical or logical path.

action_types.name: REBOOT_EQUIPMENT
action_types.description: Perform an approved equipment restart when diagnostically justified.

action_types.name: CORRECT_CONFIGURATION
action_types.description: Modify confirmed incorrect configuration to the validated required state.

action_types.name: CORRECT_RF_ROUTING
action_types.description: Correct confirmed improper physical RF routing.

action_types.name: RESEAT_RF_CONNECTION
action_types.description: Correctly reseat, secure, or remate a confirmed suspect RF connection according to applicable procedure.

action_types.name: REPLACE_RADIO
action_types.description: Replace a confirmed failed or unsuitable radio.

action_types.name: REPLACE_RF_COMPONENT
action_types.description: Replace a confirmed failed, damaged, incompatible, or unsuitable RF component.

action_types.name: CORRECT_POLARIZATION
action_types.description: Correct confirmed antenna or RF-path polarization error according to applicable design.

action_types.name: RECHECK_RSL
action_types.description: Obtain RSL after a test or corrective action and compare against the previous and expected condition.

action_types.name: RECHECK_ERROR_PERFORMANCE
action_types.description: Review error-performance measurements after a test or corrective action.

action_types.name: VERIFY_LINK_STABILITY
action_types.description: Observe the link for sufficient time and evidence to establish that the corrected condition remains stable.

action_types.name: VERIFY_RESOLUTION
action_types.description: Confirm that the original symptoms have been eliminated or returned to acceptable condition following corrective action.

action_types.name: REQUEST_SCREENSHOT
action_types.description: Request a screenshot containing technical information required to evaluate the current case.

action_types.name: REQUEST_PHOTO
action_types.description: Request a photograph of equipment, connections, installation, antenna, path, or another physical condition.

action_types.name: REQUEST_CONFIGURATION
action_types.description: Request relevant configuration values, export, file, or screenshots.

action_types.name: REQUEST_MEASUREMENT
action_types.description: Request a specific technical measurement required to advance diagnosis.

action_types.name: REQUEST_CLARIFICATION
action_types.description: Request clarification when existing information is ambiguous, incomplete, contradictory, or insufficiently precise.

action_types.name: ESCALATE_FOR_SPECIALIST_REVIEW
action_types.description: Escalate the case when available evidence, permissions, safety constraints, or ARIA confidence do not justify continued autonomous diagnostic direction.

invasiveness_levels.NONE: Read-only observation, calculation, comparison, or information gathering with no expected physical or service impact.
invasiveness_levels.LOW: Inspection or measurement with minimal expected system impact.
invasiveness_levels.MEDIUM: Action modifies system state or physical condition but is generally limited in scope.
invasiveness_levels.HIGH: Action can materially alter equipment state, RF path, configuration, service, or physical installation.

semantic_rules.rule: An action being registered means ARIA may reason about the action. It does not independently authorize ARIA or a user to perform the action.
ARIA shall prefer evidence-gathering actions that efficiently discriminate between competing hypotheses before recommending invasive corrective actions when practical.
Corrective actions should follow sufficient evidence supporting the suspected failure unless immediate action is required by an applicable safety, operational, or restoration procedure.
After a corrective action, ARIA shall seek validation evidence demonstrating whether the original symptom changed as predicted.
Failure of an action to produce its predicted result constitutes new evidence and shall trigger probability recalculation rather than automatic repetition or backtracking.
ARIA shall preserve the distinction between diagnostic actions, isolation tests, corrective actions, and validation actions.
Manufacturer-specific procedures shall attach to canonical actions through the Knowledge Graph rather than creating duplicate action types unless the action is technically distinct.

Routing priority shall not be based solely on failure probability. Expected information gain, action cost, execution time, invasiveness, service impact, safety, available evidence, user history, and context may alter the preferred next action.
ARIA shall not treat completion of an action as proof of diagnosis. The result produced by the action is the evidence used for subsequent reasoning.
When a requested action cannot be performed, ARIA should seek an alternate evidence path rather than simply restarting the previous diagnostic route.
